body: Review fixes in contrib/archive: zip detected by EOCD (polyglots) plus streamed-entry tail check; plain gzip walked as one-entry archive; Extract refuses existing keys (IfNotExists, Stat fallback) with ExtractOptions.Overwrite, cleanup deletes only created keys; DenyExecutablesWith + DefaultExecutableExtensions, trailing dot/space normalisation; case-insensitive duplicate refusal; pax global headers skipped; MaxNested (64 MiB). Each break-verified.
